newsitem.title: USA: AT&T responds to talks between BT and MCI.
newsitem.headline: AT&T responds to talks between BT and MCI.

text.p: AT&T Corp late Friday said it was confident that any change in the business arrangement between MCI Corp and British Telecommunications Plc would receive proper scrutiny by the U.S. goverment.
AT&T issued the statment in response to MCI's confirmation that it was in discussions about a possible takeover by BT.

"Although nothing conclusive has been announced yet involving a change in the current business arrangement between MCI and British Telecommunications PLC, we're confident that any such deal would get the scrutiny it deserves from the U.S. Department of Justice and Federal Communications Commission," AT&T said in the statement, released after trading closed in New York.
"We would expect that our government would condition any such merger on the complete and unqualified opening of the telecom market in the United Kingdom," it said.
